Question
========
Which of the following is NOT one of the four forces named in the synthesis of chapter 3?

Answerlist
----------
* Lack of individual effort
* Technological change without fair rewards
* Financialisation and asset inflation
* Institutional weakening of countervailing powers

Solution
========
The synthesis names technological change, globalisation, financialisation, and institutional weakening. Together they make inequality self-reinforcing.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
